head.name: @fzlt/core/debug
head.lead: Development-only checks. guardLayout(engine) counts every layout read (rects, offset/client/scroll sizes, computed style) made while the engine is in its STEP phase, the contract's "no layout reads in the tick". touchLog() puts an on-screen log of pointer and touch events on a real phone. Never ship this in a production build.

items.doc: An on-screen log of the last pointer and touch events on the page (type, pointer type and id or the touch count, x, y, and the element hit; each line starts with ms since start, inside open shadow roots too), for finding why a control doesn't answer on a real phone. A fixed box that never takes a touch itself; listeners are passive and capture on window, so nothing is cancelled or stopped. Nothing is saved or sent. Dev only: wire it to your own query flag. stop() removes the box and every listener.
